aboutMe.text: A room without books is like a body without a soul.
aboutMe.author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

books.text: I have always imagined that Paradise will be a kind of library.
books.author: Jorge Luis Borges

mysteryBook.text: There is nothing more deceptive than an obvious fact.
mysteryBook.author: Arthur Conan Doyle

thoughts.text: I write entirely to find out what I'm thinking.
thoughts.author: Joan Didion

settings.text: Once you learn to read, you will be forever free.
settings.author: Frederick Douglass

poem.text:
You will not tire.
You will walk on,
climbing ever higher into the mountains.

All it takes is spirit.
You were never meant to need wings.
poem.mark: You were never meant to need wings.
poem.author: Paruyr Sevak, To My Son, 1955

bacon.pre: Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed, and some few to be
bacon.author: Francis Bacon, Of Studies (1625)

thoreau.post: and the fit inheritance of generations and nations.
thoreau.author: Henry David Thoreau, Walden (1854)

thoughts.title: Thoughts
thoughts.subtitle: Write down what you don't want to lose.

intro.body: A quiet place to capture an idea, a question, or a line worth remembering. Link a thought to the book that inspired it, mark the ones that matter, and look back through Recent or Favorites whenever you want to retrace your thinking.

write.title: Write freely
write.body: No prompts, no structure — just a title, if you want one, and whatever's on your mind.

link.title: Link it to a book
link.body: Connect a thought to the book that inspired it, right from the thought itself.

find.title: Find it again
find.body: Favorite the ones that matter, and filter by Recent, Favorites or With Books to look back.

intro.closingQuote: We write to taste life twice, in the moment and in retrospect.
intro.rightEyebrow: Every thought has a place here.
